rules.title: How to play
rules.r1: Put your finger (or the mouse) on the ball and swipe towards the spot you want to hit: where your swipe ends is your target.
rules.r2: Power comes from the fastest moment of your swipe: swipe fast and the shot is hard enough to beat the keeper. The yellow end of the bar is too weak, the red end is too strong (the ball balloons). Draw a curved path and the ball curls around the wall.
rules.r3: Each series has 5 shots; the ball position, the wall and the keeper's movement change every shot.

tip.title: How to play
tip.l1: Swipe from the ball towards the goal: the dashed line shows the path the ball will take.
tip.l2: Swipe fast for a hard shot. Stay in the green zone of the bar; in the red the ball balloons.
tip.l3: Draw a curved path and the ball curls around the wall.
